label: Browser Automation
title: Browser Automation
subtitle: Opens a real browser that the agent can control interactively — navigating pages, clicking buttons, filling forms, scrolling, and taking screenshots. Use this when Web Search is not enough and the agent needs to interact with a web interface.
whenToUse: Use when the target page requires login, loads content after interaction, has forms the agent needs to fill, or when you need the agent to take actions on a website rather than just read from it. Needs a Chromium-based browser: it uses Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge if either is already installed, and otherwise asks permission to download one. It only reaches the public web: an address on your own machine or network, such as a development server on localhost, is refused, and so is anything the page it opened tries to load from one.

methods.name: Start Browser Session
methods.description: Opens a new headless browser instance and navigates to a starting URL. Must be called before any other browser methods.

methods.name: Navigate to URL
methods.description: Navigates the current session to a new URL.

methods.name: Take Screenshot
methods.description: Captures the current page and annotates every interactive element with a numbered index for use in subsequent click/type actions.

methods.name: Click Element
methods.description: Clicks the element with the given index number from the last screenshot.

methods.name: Type Text
methods.description: Types text into the currently focused input field.

methods.name: Scroll Page
methods.description: Scrolls the page up or down by a given amount.

methods.name: Select Dropdown Option
methods.description: Chooses a value from a select/dropdown element.

methods.name: Extract Page Content
methods.description: Returns the text content and structure of the current page.

methods.name: Close Browser Session
methods.description: Closes the browser session and frees resources. Always call this when done.

mediaCaption: A browser screenshot inline in chat showing a rendered page with numbered red boxes on each clickable element
tips: The agent must take a screenshot before it can click anything — element indices come from the screenshot annotations.
Set this tool to Ask-level approval if the agent will be interacting with live systems.
